timestampBasis: Recorded chat turn start and completion windows in UTC; a quoted reply may occur later within its turn. Duration is the recorded session duration, not active human work time.
outcomeBasis: Summaries of recorded final responses, not fresh implementation verification. Test totals describe individual iterations and are not cumulative. Later milestones may extend beyond the frozen research-paper and source snapshot.

events.promptExcerpt: Do deep research initially to design and plan how we are going to build the solutions to this.
events.title: Research the organizational graph workflow
events.outcome: Designed ingestion, identity resolution, relationship inference, evidence review, corrections, and export. Compared research approaches and separated reporting, authority, teams, and influence in the proposed architecture.

events.promptExcerpt: Not yet, but let's build an implementation plan, project design, and then we can find a dataset that can be plugged in.
events.title: Design a pluggable temporal graph system
events.outcome: Designed pluggable datasets, temporal history, bounded graph retrieval, an analyst interface, and scale evaluation. Reviewed the design and checked its documentation.

events.promptExcerpt: Build stronger completion, polish, inferred features and abilities.
events.title: Define analyst workflows and acceptance criteria
events.outcome: Expanded the design with team discovery, communication comparisons, review behavior, resumable runs, durable corrections, and reproducible exports. Specified 17 acceptance scenarios and completion gates.

events.promptExcerpt: Enhance the current build specs for this project, infer additional features and implied understanding.
events.title: Turn the brief into a testable specification
events.outcome: Expanded the specification with saved investigations, two baseline scopes, paired evidence, reversible reviews, exports, and explicit temporal behavior. Mapped 12 requirements to 31 acceptance scenarios and distinguished core from optional scope.

events.title: Build the organization analysis workspace
events.outcome: Built import, inference, evidence review, correction and undo, snapshot comparison, and export. Recorded 95 Python tests and four layout tests passing, plus a 100,000-person synthetic hierarchy benchmark.

events.title: Build the temporal discovery core
events.outcome: Built a SQLite engine and command-line interface with versioned ingestion, temporal queries, baselines, investigations, and evidence exports. Recorded 71 tests passing and nine of nine demo checks on authored fixtures.

events.title: Add local models and a browser workspace
events.outcome: Added a browser workspace, local-model extraction and embeddings, dense and hybrid retrieval, backups, and installable distributions without a paid API dependency. Recorded 121 tests, clean offline installation, local inference, and desktop/mobile browser verification.

events.promptExcerpt: Can you build out the synthetic dataset to 10,000
events.title: Expand the synthetic organization to 10,000 people
events.outcome: Loaded 10,000 people, 76,680 synthetic messages, and 45 organizational units while preserving existing records and history. Recorded 114 tests passing and browser navigation verification.

events.promptExcerpt: when zoomed out it shows general departments and groups but zooming in allows you to see all the way down to an individual connection and position level.
events.title: Navigate from departments to individual connections
events.outcome: Added semantic zoom from departments and groups through reporting branches to positions and connections, with breadcrumbs and evidence markers. Recorded 121 backend and 21 frontend tests passing.

events.promptExcerpt: Contnue build, and please greatly polish surface level identification, usability, and robust interfaces.
events.title: Polish the analyst workspace
events.outcome: Added a responsive dark interface, snapshot navigation, graph controls, clearer provenance, protected drafts, and restored investigations. Recorded 145 tests plus offline installation and desktop/mobile workflow verification.

events.promptExcerpt: It needs to be smoother, and it needs to have seamless scrolling
events.title: Smooth chart movement and continuous loading
events.outcome: Added smoother zoom, continuous loading, and preserved scroll position. Recorded 66 tests and a production build passing, with browser verification.

events.promptExcerpt: Polish, remove fluf, remove anything that deviates from the prompt.
events.title: Focus the interface on the research workflow
events.outcome: Removed invented branding, slogans, duplicate headings, and visual clutter while preserving the core GraphRAG workflows. Recorded 39 checks plus desktop, mobile, and offline installation verification.

events.promptExcerpt: I want more connections at further scrolls, and have the default be zoom not scroll, and have mouse-over have information
events.title: Reveal more connections and hover details
events.outcome: Made wheel input default to zoom and expanded visible connections through 30, 80, and 200 people as zoom increased. Added person, group, and reporting-link hover details; recorded 85 tests and a build passing.

events.promptExcerpt: Make it so that live as you type, there are animations that show the connections being built, the evidence being connected, and nodes highlighting for illustration of what is going on
events.title: Animate connections while the analyst types
events.outcome: Added live relationship animation, source-evidence connections, highlighted nodes, click-to-trace support, and reduced-motion behavior. Recorded 168 tests passing and a rebuilt package with offline installation verification.

events.promptExcerpt: it asks if you want to import a dataset, or if you want to view synthetic dataset.
events.title: Preview a dataset before saving it
events.outcome: Added an import-or-synthetic chooser and an animated six-step walkthrough covering dataset size, people, fields, quality, and graph preview before saving. Included a review checkpoint, replay, and workspace resume; recorded 144 backend and 99 frontend tests passing.

events.promptExcerpt: Add a tab on the left with program instructions
events.title: Add program instructions in the sidebar
events.outcome: Added an Instructions tab with a quick start, workflows, local-model guidance, troubleshooting, and shortcuts. Recorded desktop/mobile verification and 30 tests passing.

events.promptExcerpt: make it a little clearer what the 'next step' should be with green buttons prompting for continuance.
events.title: Animate the workflow and clarify the next step
events.outcome: Added automatic stages, gradual node highlights and connecting lines, playback controls, and green next-step buttons. Added recovery behavior and accurate group totals; recorded 158 backend and 121 frontend tests passing.

events.promptExcerpt: Build a much larger dataset to see connections.
events.title: Create a guided exploration of a larger synthetic graph
events.outcome: Added a Start here walkthrough from question to connections, evidence, comparison, and notes, alongside 1,281 synthetic entities, 5,125 active relationships, and six snapshots. Recorded 157 Python and 42 frontend checks passing, plus offline Windows package verification.
